SELECT p.PROJ_ID as "projId", p.PROJ_NAME as "projName", p.PROJ_TYPE as "projType", p.WS_ID as "wsId", w.WS_NAME as "wsName", w.WS_IMAGE_PATH as "wsImagePath", p.LEADER_ID as "leaderId", leader.USER_NAME as "ownerName", leader.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH as "ownerProfileImagePath", NVL(p.PROJ_SCOPE, CASE WHEN p.WS_ID IS NULL THEN 'PERSONAL' ELSE 'GROUP' END) as "projScope", TO_CHAR(pd.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "startDate", TO_CHAR(pd.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "endDate", NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') as "projectRecordStatus", CASE WHEN pd.START_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.START_DT) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'SCHEDULED' WHEN pd.END_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(pd.END_DT) < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END as "projectStatus", CASE WHEN p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'LEADER' ELSE NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER') END as "projRole" FROM PROJECTS p JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON p.PROJ_ID = pm.PROJ_ID LEFT JOIN WORKSPACES w ON p.WS_ID = w.WS_ID LEFT JOIN USERS leader ON leader.USER_ID = p.LEADER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PROJ_ID, MIN(START_DT) AS START_DT, MAX(END_DT) AS END_DT FROM EVENTS WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'PROJ' AND EVENT_TYPE = 'PROJECT_PERIOD' GROUP BY PROJ_ID ) pd ON pd.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID WHERE pm.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NVL(p.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') <> 'DELETED'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_NOTICES ( ALARM_ID, USER_ID, NOTICE_ID, ALERT_TYPE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LINK_URL, IS_READ, REG_DT ) SELECT SEQ_ALARM_ID.NEXTVAL, r.USER_ID, NULL, 'CALENDAR_REMINDER', 'CALENDAR', #{eventId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', SYSDATE FROM ( SELECT #{ownerId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL UNION SELECT ea.USER_ID FROM EVENT_ATTENDEES ea WHERE ea.EVENT_ID = #{eventId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) r WHERE r.USER_ID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_NOTICES un WHERE un.USER_ID = r.USER_ID AND un.ALERT_TYPE = 'CALENDAR_REMINDER' AND un.TARGET_TYPE = 'CALENDAR' AND un.TARGET_ID = #{eventId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
